## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Documentation updated when public behavior changed
- [ ] No real credentials, private targets, raw evidence, or generated `artifacts/` included

## Screenshots

Add before/after images for rendering changes. Use synthetic or explicitly approved evidence only.
